poured.title: How decants are poured
poured.lead: From a full bottle to your door, poured to order.

steps.title: Drawn from a full bottle
steps.text: Every decant starts with an authentic full bottle. A sterile syringe draws the fragrance straight from it, and the tools are cleaned between fragrances so scents never mix.

steps.title: Into a new glass atomizer
steps.text: Each decant goes into a brand-new Evrair atomizer: a pressurized glass bottle with a gold metal sprayer crimped on. Atomizers are never reused.

steps.title: Labelled, sealed and packed
steps.text: Labelled with the house and the fragrance, sealed so it can’t leak in the mail, and packed to travel safely.

steps.title: Posted within 1–2 business days
steps.text: Poured and posted within one to two business days of your order, from {location}. Lettermail is {lettermailCost}, free from {lettermailFree}; tracked is {trackedCost}, free from {trackedFree}.
